summary: First Majestic Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual General Meeting and Management Information Circular. The filing details routine shareholder matters: setting board size at six, electing directors, appointing Deloitte LLP as auditor, an advisory vote on executive compensation, and approval of unallocated entitlements under the long-term incentive plan. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is announced. This is a standard annual meeting circular, not a special-situation event.
